title: VPS ops & nightly data pipeline
description: A nightly n8n workflow that health-checks a VPS over SSH, clears disk pressure, takes a verified backup, and loads data into Postgres only if it passes SQL quality checks. Built by Dyaksa.
intro: A nightly n8n workflow that health-checks a server over SSH, clears a full disk, takes a backup it actually verifies, and loads the day's data into Postgres only if it passes quality checks. Scroll to follow one night through all 24 nodes.

stations.title: The server reports on itself, in JSON.
stations.body: At 02:00, n8n runs a Bash healthcheck over SSH: disk, memory, load, unhealthy containers, failed systemd units and TLS expiry. If the output isn't JSON, the Code node throws, because a silent parse failure would look exactly like a healthy server.
stations.code: catch (e) { throw new Error(`vps_healthcheck.sh returned non-JSON: ${raw.slice(0,300)}`); }

stations.title: A full disk is cleared, then checked again.
stations.body: Above 85% disk, it prunes Docker images and containers older than a week and trims the system journal, then reads disk usage again. Only if it is still over 85% does #ops get an alert.
check: Reclaim Disk Space → Re-Check Disk → Still Full?

stations.title: A backup counts only if it can be read back.
stations.body: A script tars each Docker volume, checksums it and reads the archive back. The Code node then requires the archive to exist, be over 1 MiB and have a verified checksum. An exit code of 0 proves nothing on its own.
stations.code: backupOk: Boolean(r.archive) && Number(r.bytes) > MIN_BYTES && r.checksum_verified === true,

stations.title: No verified backup, no data load.
stations.body: If the backup failed, #ops is told and the ETL is skipped for the night. Loading data on a night with no backup is the wrong risk to take.
check: Backup Good? · false → Alert Backup Failure

stations.title: Re-running a failed night can't double-count.
stations.body: A Python ETL loads the last 24 hours into Postgres. Event IDs are a hash of each event's fields, duplicates are dropped within the batch, and rows are upserted with ON CONFLICT in one transaction. Database credentials stay on the server, never in the command n8n logs.

stations.title: SQL checks the load before anyone sees it.
stations.body: The Postgres node counts today's rows, null keys and duplicate keys, and compares volume with the trailing seven days. No rows, any null or duplicate key, or less than 40% of the usual volume fails the load.
stations.code:
if (rows === 0)                              failures.push('no_rows_loaded');
if (prior > 0 && rows < prior * 0.4)         failures.push(`volume_drop rows=${rows} vs avg=${prior}`);
check: Data Quality Checks → Assert Data Quality

stations.title: A bad load is moved aside, not shown.
stations.body: Failing rows move to events_quarantine with the reason, and #ops hears that the dashboards are still on yesterday's data. Stale but correct beats fresh but wrong.
check: Data Quality Passed? · false → Quarantine → Slack

stations.title: A good night ends in one row and one message.
stations.body: The run is logged to the Ops Log sheet with disk, memory, backup archive, rows loaded and the quality result. Then #ops gets a one-line digest.
check: Log Nightly Run → Post Nightly Digest

stations.title: If a script returns garbage, engineering hears.
stations.body: Parse failures throw on purpose. The Error Trigger posts the failing node, the error and the execution link to #eng-alerts.

stations.title: 24 nodes, and every stage checks its own work.
stations.body: Healthcheck, backup and load each verify their output before the next stage runs. The scripts report and the workflow decides, so every script can also be run by hand during an incident.

edgeCases: Healthcheck prints a traceback instead of JSON
Self-healed silently, or escalated if still full
Backup “succeeds” but is tiny or corrupt
Backup alert. ETL skipped for the night
Overlapping rotated logs produce duplicate lines
No double counting. Re-run is safe
ETL loads 0 rows or a partial day
Reported as data. The healthcheck still completes
notBuilt: Monthly restore test into a scratch container, asserting row counts
Dead-letter replay that re-processes quarantined rows once the upstream is fixed
Metrics to a Prometheus exporter instead of Sheets
Off-site replication of verified archives, plus dbt or great_expectations tests
